sloka: गज अश्व रथ संबाधे बले महति तिष्ठता ।कृतम् सुदारुणम् कर्म सर्व लोक जुगुप्सितम् ॥३-२९-२॥
transliteration: gaja aśva ratha saṁbādhe bale mahati tiṣṭhatā ।kṛtam sudāruṇam karma sarva loka jugupsitam ॥3-29-2॥

translations.english: Although you command a huge army with many elephants, horses, chariots, etc. you have done such cruel deeds that the entire world despises you.
